units.source: Changing the location of data directory__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: If you want to use some other location for the data directory than the default one, you may change it via __TRILIUM_PH_0__ environment variable to some other location:
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__ Windows
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ key on your keyboard.
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: Search and select __TRILIUM_PH_0__Edit the system variables__TRILIUM_PH_1__.
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Environment Variables…__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button in the bottom-right of the newly opened screen.
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: On the top section (__TRILIUM_PH_0__User variables for [user]__TRILIUM_PH_1__), press the __TRILIUM_PH_2__New…__TRILIUM_PH_3__ button.
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: In the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Variable name__TRILIUM_PH_1__ field insert __TRILIUM_PH_2__.
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Browse Directory…__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button and select the new directory where to store the database.
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: Close all the windows by pressing the __TRILIUM_PH_0__OK__TRILIUM_PH_1__ button for each of them.
units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.context: Data directory > Location of the data directory > Changing the location of data directory

units.source: Electron user data directory (desktop only)__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Data directory > Electron user data directory (desktop only)

units.source: When running the desktop application, Electron stores internal data (caches, spell-check dictionaries, session storage, etc.) separately from the Trilium data directory. By default this goes to the system's application data folder (e.g. __TRILIUM_PH_0__ on Windows), which may be undesirable in corporate environments with roaming profiles or when running in portable mode.
units.context: Data directory > Electron user data directory (desktop only)

units.source: To keep Electron data out of the system's roaming profile, set the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ environment variable to an explicit path. The __TRILIUM_PH_1__ script does this automatically, pointing it to __TRILIUM_PH_2__ next to the application.
units.context: Data directory > Electron user data directory (desktop only)
